must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Spec sheet: the core of the page is one long two-column key/value table (Providers, Clients, Data location, Storage, Approval, Revoke, Plans) with screenshots between table groups.
layout.why: Technical buyers get every fact on one scan.

hero.idea: One muted looping clip (about 12 seconds): a question typed in Claude, the draft card appears, the user clicks Approve, 'Sent' shows.
hero.why: The whole value loop in one clip.

visual_style.idea: Museum white: pure white, objects (3D envelope, draft card) shot with soft contact shadows, grey captions, very wide spacing.
visual_style.why: Calm, premium, and it makes the 3D objects feel collected rather than decorative.

typography.idea: Familjen Grotesk 600 headings (from a Stockholm foundry), Literata 400 body at 18px, Familjen Grotesk 500 for buttons.
typography.why: Quietly ties the type to Stockholm, where the data lives.

narrative.idea: Founder letter: why the product exists and what it promises, signed, with features as a short P.S. list.
narrative.why: A small company's best proof is a real person.

proof.idea: Security model block with four plain statements: mail fetched live and never stored, credentials encrypted at rest, OAuth access revocable in one click, data stored in Stockholm.
proof.why: The four facts people actually ask about, stated plainly.

asset_use.idea: A single 3D object in the hero, then none again; the rest of the page uses real screenshots only.
asset_use.why: Lets the object be memorable without becoming decoration.

motion.idea: A thin cobalt reading-progress line in the left index of the long-read.

section_order.idea: Hero > Real quotes > Feature rows (alternating) > Letter > Pricing > Closing CTA

voice.idea: Two readers, human and agent: sections for people with a short aside to the AI. Sample: 'Note to the agent: ask before you send.'
voice.why: Acknowledges that agents read pages too.

wildcard.idea: Each section header shows the date it was last updated, taken from git.
